fields.description:
Objective

Simplify the Sign-Up core status set and separate fraud from lifecycle state.

Implementation Requirements

* Final Status values: New; In Progress; Completed; Archived

* Fraud tracked via Fraud Flag + Fraud Review Status, not as a core status

* Rename all "Flagged" naming to "Fraud" (button, fields, labels)

* Flag for Fraud button sets Fraud Review Status = Suspected and does NOT change core Status

* If Ops confirms fraud, lock the record from Rep edits

* Completed Sign-Ups flagged as fraud remain Completed; the fraud sub-status excludes them from reporting and P&L rollups while the record stays real

Acceptance Criteria

* Status picklist contains exactly four values

* Flagging a Completed Sign-Up leaves it Completed

* No user-facing label uses the word Flagged for fraud

Additional Notes

CHANGE REQUEST against BUILD-10 (Doc #1). Downstream impact: BUILD-48 (list views), BUILD-53 (Fraud button/flow), BUILD-34 (fraud automations), POC-19 (Path component — now cancelled), BUILD-05 (transition rules removed from scope).

Source: Wagertech Additional User Stories, July 2026 — item 17.
